diagnostics.message: splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_cloudwatchlogs sets the variable "REPORT-forgecicd_trust_validation" = "forgecicd_trust_validation", referencing the transform stanza managed by splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_trust_validation, but has no implicit or explicit dependency on it. Unlike the other REPORT-* entries (which are backed by depends_on entries), this transform could be created/updated out of order, leaving the props/aws:cloudwatchlogs stanza pointing at a missing or stale transform.

splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_cloudwatchlogs sets the variable "REPORT-forgecicd_extra_lambda_ec2_tenant_fields" = "forgecicd_extra_lambda_ec2_tenant_fields", referencing the transform stanza managed by splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_extra_lambda_ec2_tenant_fields, but has no implicit or explicit dependency on it. Its depends_on covers the lambda/global/extra_lambda tenant-field transforms but omits this one, so the props stanza may be applied before the transform it references exists.
